findings.text: the _SupersededLaunchError docstring still says it is 'Raised only at the pre-spawn fence', but the reviewed commit adds a second raise site through _refuse_if_superseded at :3671 before the shared spec write, so the docstring now misdescribes the refusal's reach; a reader deciding whether an early unwind is this error is told it cannot happen before the spawn.

_prepare_attempt_records still runs before the pre-spec fence at :3671, and it overwrites the canonical attempt record and unlinks the canonical worker and exit records; in a run whose newer attempt has written those but whose worker is not yet live the live_worker_reading guard does not fire, so an abandoning launch can still retire records the newer attempt owns. This ordering predates the reviewed commits and the test's stall hook deliberately sits after it, so the new spec assertion cannot see it.
